title: Chandragupta Maurya
biography: Founder of the Maurya Empire with guidance from his guru Chanakya (Kautilya). Defeated Seleucus I Nicator and unified the Indian subcontinent from Bengal to Afghanistan under centralized rule.
internationalConnections: Concluded a treaty of alliance with Seleucus I Nicator, welcoming Greek ambassador Megasthenes to Pataliputra.
